source_type_ambiguities: SERNAC Chile alert (F-08) classified as "news" — government consumer protection agency press alert; no exact match in closed list. tuQuejaSuma (F-P05, F-P06) classified as "unknown" per Trustpilot/BBB analogy rule. Domestika forum posts by Staff (F-09, F-10, F-P04) classified as "seller_forum" — platform-operated forum where staff delivers policy statements; these function as platform_doc content delivered through a forum channel.
coverage_gaps_by_dimension:
- **Currency:** Well covered. USD-only billing confirmed via multiple policy and staff sources. dLocal identified as LatAm payment processor. Exchange rate markup percentages not documented (F-X05).
- **Tax:** Buyer-side: user responsible for "impuestos aplicables" per terms. Argentine Impuesto País mechanism well-documented in forum posts but mostly outside time window. Mexico RFC/SAT incompatibility documented but outside time window. Seller-side: no withholding rates, no W-8BEN/1099 documentation found (F-X02, F-X03).
- **Availability:** Sanctions-based restrictions documented. Country-specific payment method availability partially documented (Peru: card/PayPal; Mexico/Colombia/Brazil: cash/transfer). Chile: SERNAC confirms no formal presence. No seller account eligibility criteria found (F-X04).
- **Payout:** Weakest dimension. Privacy policy confirms Domestika processes "pago de honorarios" for instructors and collects fiscal ID/nationality. No specific payout methods, thresholds, timing, or country-specific rules found in any public source (F-X01). Instructor payout appears governed by private contracts.
decomposition_issues: SD-08 (seller payout experience) returned no valid findings within time window or language scope. All instructor payout content found was either English-language (Spanish blog instructoresonline.es and lorenaibanez.com discuss general payout model but without LatAm-specific cross-border details and without country/currency specifics sufficient for D6), or lacked the explicit cross-border element required by the shard.
time_window_impact: Most detailed cross-border experience content (especially Argentine tax mechanics) comes from Domestika forum posts dated 2020–2023, outside the April 2025–April 2026 window for reported experiences. In-window experience sources are limited to SERNAC Chile (May 2025) and tuQuejaSuma complaints (various 2025 dates, some undated). Platform-declared policy findings (Terms, Privacy, staff responses) are not subject to the time window.
trustpilot_access: Trustpilot review pages for domestika.org (both trustpilot.com and es.trustpilot.com) were blocked by robots.txt on direct fetch. Spanish-language Trustpilot reviews with cross-border elements were not recoverable from search engine snippets with sufficient specificity (country/currency named) to qualify as D6 findings.
